experiment_data.hypothesis: Temperature variation (t=0.0/0.3/0.7/1.0) changes pairwise MI between judges, thereby changing K_eff. If temperature is a valid instrument for K_eff manipulation, it provides quasi-experimental evidence that K_eff causally affects panel ASR, not just correlationally.

spec.model_name: 3 API models (gpt-4.1-nano, gemini-3.5-flash, claude-3-haiku) x 4 temperatures (0.0, 0.3, 0.7, 1.0)
